nodes.name: NavEdgeSwipe.svelte
nodes.summary: Invisible shell helper that wires a left-edge swipe gesture to open the mobile sidebar drawer; renders nothing and is active on iOS/Android only.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Svelte action (use:edgeSwipe) to attach window listeners to a hidden node.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the QRCode component from qrcode.svelte for a clean public import path.

nodes.name: qrcode.svelte
nodes.summary: Renders a value as a dot-style SVG QR code with rounded finder patterns, using the qrcode package to compute the module matrix and Svelte $derived to lay out circles.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of $derived/$derived.by to recompute the SVG geometry reactively from the QR module matrix.

nodes.name: DeviceGlyph.svelte
nodes.summary: Small framed laptop icon shown while connecting to a trusted device, tinted by the surrounding transfer panel's accent.

nodes.name: FileCard.svelte
nodes.summary: Grid tile for a queued file showing an extension glyph or inline image thumbnail plus name/size, with a hover/focus remove button.
nodes.languageNotes: Tracks per-path ready/failed state instead of boolean flags so thumbnails reset automatically when a tile is reused.

nodes.name: Mascot.svelte
nodes.summary: Pixel-art floppy-disk mascot drawn as an inline SVG of rects, recolored per accent (send=orange, receive=blue) via a shared palette merged with accent-specific shell colors.
nodes.languageNotes: One drawing parameterized by an accent-derived color map; only shell and label-stripe colors vary between send/receive.

nodes.name: ModeSwitcher.svelte
nodes.summary: Tab control that toggles the app between Send and Receive modes, with Cmd/Ctrl+1/2 keyboard shortcuts and a busy spinner per mode.

nodes.name: TransferCard.svelte
nodes.summary: Shared card chrome for the send and receive panels: accent-tinted header with title, status line, badge, optional alert, an anchored actions zone, and file-drop-target opt-in.
nodes.languageNotes: Publishes the accent as CSS custom properties (--tint/--tint-fg) and uses @container queries so children respond to card width, not viewport.

nodes.name: TransferProgress.svelte
nodes.summary: Progress display for an in-flight transfer showing a tweened percentage, bar, and a detail line of bytes/rate/ETA, falling back to a spinner when no progress is known.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Svelte's Tween.of to smoothly animate the percentage toward the reported progress.

nodes.name: WaitingHint.svelte
nodes.summary: Small 'still working' footer line for transfer panels: a spinner beside an uppercase status label.

nodes.name: files.ts
nodes.summary: File helpers for the transfer queue: derive a short uppercase extension badge, test whether a file is a previewable image, and build a thumbnail URL via the thumb:// custom protocol.

nodes.name: ReceiveCodeForm.svelte
nodes.summary: Idle-state receive form with a code input and Get-the-files button, including clipboard auto-fill of a complete code on mount and window focus with one-click undo.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads the native clipboard only on discrete focus moments via $effect + onWindowFocus, guarding against overwriting user input and re-filling dismissed values.

nodes.name: ReceiveComplete.svelte
nodes.summary: Done-state screen for a completed receive, confirming success and showing where the files were saved.

nodes.name: ReceiveDevice.svelte
nodes.summary: Connecting-state screen for an accepted device receive, naming the sender and previewing the incoming file count and total size before bytes arrive.

nodes.name: ReceiveIdle.svelte
nodes.summary: Idle hero screen for the receive panel showing the receive-accent mascot and a prompt to enter the sender's code; the input itself lives in the card's actions zone.

nodes.name: ReceivePanel.svelte
nodes.summary: Top-level receive panel that maps each receive-flow status (idle, connecting, receiving, done, cancelling) to a sub-screen and renders the appropriate actions inside a TransferCard.
nodes.languageNotes: Derives headline/badge from receive state and branches the card body on app.receive.status.

nodes.name: ReceiveSearching.svelte
nodes.summary: Connecting-state screen for a code receive, shown while searching for the sender before a connection is established.

nodes.name: SendCode.svelte
nodes.summary: Waiting-state screen for a code send that displays the share phrase as a QR code and copyable text, with an animated border beam signalling it is still waiting for a peer.
nodes.languageNotes: Copies via the native Go-side clipboard with a navigator.clipboard fallback; embeds the QRCode component and a motion-gated BorderBeam.

nodes.name: SendComplete.svelte
nodes.summary: Done-state screen for a completed send, summarizing what was sent and to which target.

nodes.name: SendDevice.svelte
nodes.summary: Pre-transfer screen for a device send covering both the waiting-for-acceptance and accepted/connecting states, with no code or QR since the peer is derived from pairing keys.

nodes.name: SendPanel.svelte
nodes.summary: Top-level send panel that manages the target selection (code or trusted device), maps each send-flow status to a sub-screen, warns on large transfers, and dispatches the send inside a drop-accepting TransferCard.
nodes.languageNotes: Derives the effective target so un-trusting a device falls back to code without an effect; dispatchSend routes to send.start() or pairing.sendTo().

nodes.name: SendQueue.svelte
nodes.summary: Idle send screen showing either a drop/browse empty state with mascot or a responsive grid of FileCard tiles for the queued files, plus an in-grid Add-files tile.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses animate:flip for tile motion on removal and container-query grid columns keyed off the card width.

nodes.name: SendTargetPicker.svelte
nodes.summary: Bindable picker choosing where files are sent — a shared code or a trusted device fingerprint — and surfacing the pairing entry point when no devices exist yet.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a $bindable value prop and derives the display label from the pairing device list.

nodes.name: badge.svelte
nodes.summary: shadcn-style Badge primitive rendering a span or anchor with tailwind-variants-driven style variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link).
nodes.languageNotes: Defines badgeVariants and the BadgeVariant type in a module <script>, consumed by the instance script and re-exported via index.ts.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the Badge component along with its badgeVariants and BadgeVariant type.

nodes.name: ext
nodes.summary: Returns a short uppercase file extension (up to 4 chars) for the file-row badge, or 'FILE' when there is no extension.

nodes.name: isPreviewable
nodes.summary: Reports whether a file's extension is in the set of image types the webview can render inline as a queue thumbnail.

nodes.name: previewURL
nodes.summary: Builds a webview-loadable URL for a local file preview via Tauri's convertFileSrc over the thumb:// custom protocol.
